request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

messages.content:
Rule BR-CBTRN02C-005: Route each daily transaction to posting or to the reject file, and set return code 4 when any are rejected

### given[0]: Records are read one at a time from the daily transaction file until end of file. Each record that is read adds 1 to the processed-transaction count.
fields=['END-OF-FILE', 'WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT'] literals=['Y', 'N']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   198            PERFORM 0300-DALYREJS-OPEN.
   199            PERFORM 0400-ACCTFILE-OPEN.
   200            PERFORM 0500-TCATBALF-OPEN.
   201 
>> 202            PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'
>> 203                IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
>> 204                    PERFORM 1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT
>> 205                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
>> 206                      ADD 1 TO WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT
   207       *              DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD
   208                      MOVE 0 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   209                      MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   210                      PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN

### given[1]: Before each transaction is validated, the failure reason code is set to 0 and the failure description is set to spaces, so nothing from the previous transaction carries over.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC'] literals=['0']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   204                    PERFORM 1000-DALYTRAN-GET-NEXT
   205                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   206                      ADD 1 TO WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT
   207       *              DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD
>> 208                      MOVE 0 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 209                      MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 210                      PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN
   211                      IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
   212                        PERFORM 2000-POST-TRANSACTION
   213                      ELSE
   214                        ADD 1 TO WS-REJECT-COUNT

### given[2]: The validation trailer is 80 bytes: a 4-digit unsigned numeric reason code followed by a 76-character description.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-TRAILER', 'WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   176         01 REJECT-RECORD.
   177            05 REJECT-TRAN-DATA          PIC X(350).
   178            05 VALIDATION-TRAILER        PIC X(80).
   179 
>> 180         01 WS-VALIDATION-TRAILER.
>> 181            05 WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON      PIC 9(04).
>> 182            05 WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC PIC X(76).
   183 
   184         01 WS-COUNTERS.
   185            05 WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT          PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
   186            05 WS-REJECT-COUNT               PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.

### given[3]: A reject record is 430 bytes: 350 bytes of transaction data followed by an 80-byte validation trailer.
fields=['REJECT-RECORD', 'REJECT-TRAN-DATA', 'VALIDATION-TRAILER'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   172            06 DB2-DOT-3                 PIC X.
   173            06 DB2-MIL                   PIC 9(002).
   174            06 DB2-REST                  PIC X(04).
   175 
>> 176         01 REJECT-RECORD.
>> 177            05 REJECT-TRAN-DATA          PIC X(350).
>> 178            05 VALIDATION-TRAILER        PIC X(80).
   179 
   180         01 WS-VALIDATION-TRAILER.
   181            05 WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON      PIC 9(04).
   182            05 WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC PIC X(76).

### when[0]: After validation, the program checks whether the failure reason code is still 0.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON'] literals=['0']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   207       *              DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD
   208                      MOVE 0 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   209                      MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   210                      PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN
>> 211                      IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
   212                        PERFORM 2000-POST-TRANSACTION
   213                      ELSE
   214                        ADD 1 TO WS-REJECT-COUNT
   215                        PERFORM 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC

### then[0]: If the reason code is 0, the transaction is posted.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON'] literals=['0']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   207       *              DISPLAY DALYTRAN-RECORD
   208                      MOVE 0 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   209                      MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   210                      PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN
>> 211                      IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
>> 212                        PERFORM 2000-POST-TRANSACTION
   213                      ELSE
   214                        ADD 1 TO WS-REJECT-COUNT
   215                        PERFORM 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC
   216                      END-IF

### then[1]: If the reason code is not 0, the reject count goes up by 1 and a reject record is written. The transaction is not posted.
fields=['WS-REJECT-COUNT'] literals=['1']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   209                      MOVE SPACES TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   210                      PERFORM 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN
   211                      IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0
   212                        PERFORM 2000-POST-TRANSACTION
>> 213                      ELSE
>> 214                        ADD 1 TO WS-REJECT-COUNT
>> 215                        PERFORM 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC
   216                      END-IF
   217                    END-IF
   218                END-IF
   219            END-PERFORM.

### then[2]: The reject record's transaction data is the complete input daily transaction record, copied unchanged.
fields=['DALYTRAN-RECORD', 'REJECT-TRAN-DATA'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   443 
   444            EXIT.
   445 
   446        2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC.
>> 447            MOVE DALYTRAN-RECORD TO REJECT-TRAN-DATA
   448            MOVE WS-VALIDATION-TRAILER TO VALIDATION-TRAILER
   449       *     DISPLAY '***' REJECT-RECORD
   450            MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT
   451            WRITE FD-REJS-RECORD FROM REJECT-RECORD

### then[3]: The reject record's trailer is the current reason code and description from validation.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-TRAILER', 'VALIDATION-TRAILER'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   444            EXIT.
   445 
   446        2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC.
   447            MOVE DALYTRAN-RECORD TO REJECT-TRAN-DATA
>> 448            MOVE WS-VALIDATION-TRAILER TO VALIDATION-TRAILER
   449       *     DISPLAY '***' REJECT-RECORD
   450            MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT
   451            WRITE FD-REJS-RECORD FROM REJECT-RECORD
   452            IF DALYREJS-STATUS = '00'

### then[4]: The reject record is written as one record to the daily rejects file.
fields=['FD-REJS-RECORD', 'REJECT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   447            MOVE DALYTRAN-RECORD TO REJECT-TRAN-DATA
   448            MOVE WS-VALIDATION-TRAILER TO VALIDATION-TRAILER
   449       *     DISPLAY '***' REJECT-RECORD
   450            MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT
>> 451            WRITE FD-REJS-RECORD FROM REJECT-RECORD
   452            IF DALYREJS-STATUS = '00'
   453                MOVE 0 TO  APPL-RESULT
   454            ELSE
   455                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT

### then[5]: Surprising behaviour: if the account rewrite fails during posting, reason code 109 and the description ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND are set. However, the main loop never checks the reason code after posting, so no reject record is written and the reject count does not increase. The code is cleared before the next transaction.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC'] literals=['109', 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   550            ELSE
   551               ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
   552            END-IF
   553 
>> 554            REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM  ACCOUNT-RECORD
>> 555               INVALID KEY
>> 556                 MOVE 109 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 557                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
>> 558                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 559            END-REWRITE.
   560            EXIT.
   561       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   562        2900-WRITE-TRANSACTION-FILE.
   563            MOVE 8 TO  APPL-RESULT.

### then[6]: At the end of the run, the program displays the processed-transaction count and the reject count.
fields=['WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT', 'WS-REJECT-COUNT'] literals=['TRANSACTIONS PROCESSED :', 'TRANSACTIONS REJECTED  :']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   223            PERFORM 9200-XREFFILE-CLOSE.
   224            PERFORM 9300-DALYREJS-CLOSE.
   225            PERFORM 9400-ACCTFILE-CLOSE.
   226            PERFORM 9500-TCATBALF-CLOSE.
>> 227            DISPLAY 'TRANSACTIONS PROCESSED :' WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT
>> 228            DISPLAY 'TRANSACTIONS REJECTED  :' WS-REJECT-COUNT
   229            IF WS-REJECT-COUNT > 0
   230               MOVE 4 TO RETURN-CODE
   231            END-IF
   232            DISPLAY 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN02C'.

### then[7]: If at least one transaction was rejected, the return code is set to 4. Otherwise the program does not change the return code.
fields=['WS-REJECT-COUNT'] literals=['4']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   225            PERFORM 9400-ACCTFILE-CLOSE.
   226            PERFORM 9500-TCATBALF-CLOSE.
   227            DISPLAY 'TRANSACTIONS PROCESSED :' WS-TRANSACTION-COUNT
   228            DISPLAY 'TRANSACTIONS REJECTED  :' WS-REJECT-COUNT
>> 229            IF WS-REJECT-COUNT > 0
>> 230               MOVE 4 TO RETURN-CODE
>> 231            END-IF
   232            DISPLAY 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN02C'.
   233 
   234            GOBACK.
   235       *---------------------------------------------------------------*

clause.description: clause id as given, e.g. when[0]

1500-VALIDATE-TRAN."},{"clause":"given[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 180-182 define WS-VALIDATION-TRAILER as an unsigned PIC 9(04) reason code followed by a PIC X(76) description, 80 bytes in total."},{"clause":"given[3]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 176-178 define REJECT-RECORD as PIC X(350) transaction data plus a PIC X(80) trailer, 430 bytes in total."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 211 tests IF WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON = 0 right after validation."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 211-212 perform 2000-POST-TRANSACTION when the reason code equals 0."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"The ELSE branch at lines 213-215 adds 1 to WS-REJECT-COUNT and performs 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC, and REJECT-TRAN-DATA."},{"clause":"then[3]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 448 moves WS-VALIDATION-TRAILER, which holds the current reason code and description, into VALIDATION-TRAILER."},{"clause":"then[4]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 451 writes FD-REJS-RECORD FROM REJECT-RECORD as a single WRITE to the rejects file."},{"clause":"then[5]","supported":false,"reason":"The cited lines 554-559 only show that 109 and 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND' are set on INVALID KEY, while the claims that the main loop never and the reject count with the cited literals."},{"clause":"then[7]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 229-231 move 4 to RETURN-CODE only when WS-REJECT-COUNT > 0, and there is no ELSE that changes
